name: Short waves, kh = kv = 15
setup: Short waves, kh = kv = 15: only about 7 coarse cells per wavelength (training had at most 6 waves, i.e. at least 17 cells per wavelength). Run to t = 5.
expect: Waves this short are barely resolved on the coarse mesh. MCL's local bounds treat each wave crest as a potential overshoot and clip it.
observed: The limiter hurts here: q error 15% for MCL-NN vs 2.2% for the NN alone. MCL flattens the crests the network was correctly reproducing.
